Rashi on Sotah 11a:11:1.hebrew: שבשלו - לשון "ויזד יעקב נזיד" (בראשית כ״ה:כ״ט):
Rashi on Sotah 11a:11:1.english: That they cooked - An expression like "And Jacob cooked a stew" (Genesis 25:29).

Rashi on Sotah 11a:12:1.english: In that counsel - that [Pharaoh said], "Let us deal wisely with him."

Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:1.hebrew: יושבי יעבץ - תלמידי יעבץ. אדם גדול בתורה היה, כדכתיב (דברי הימים א ד׳:י׳) "ויקרא יעבץ לאלהי ישראל אם ברך תברכני" בתורה, "והרבית את גבולי" בתלמידים וגו', "ויבא אלהים את אשר שאל" (תמורה טז.):
Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:1.english: The inhabitants of Yabetz - The disciples of Yabetz. He was a great man in Torah, as it is written (I Chronicles 4:10): "And Yabetz called on the God of Israel, saying, 'If You will bless me indeed'" — with Torah — "'and enlarge my border'" — with disciples, etc. "And God granted him that which he asked" (Temurah 16a).

Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:2.hebrew: תרעתים - מפרש בספרי ששמעו תרועה בהר סיני. ל"א, תרעתים על שם שהיו יושבים בשערי ירושלים:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:2.english: Tira'atim - It is explained in the Sifrei that [they were so called because] they heard a *teru'ah* (a blast) at Mount Sinai. Another explanation: *Tira'atim* [is named] for the fact that they used to sit at the gates (*sha'arei*) of Jerusalem.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:3.hebrew: שמעתים - ששמעו מצות אביהם. דבבני יונדב בן רכב משתעי קרא, והם היו מבני בניו של יתרו, כדמפרש ואזיל: "המה הקנים":
Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:3.english: Shimeatim - Who heard the command of their father. For the verse speaks of the descendants of Jonadab son of Rechab, and they were from the grandchildren of Jethro, as it goes on to explain: "They are the Kenites."

Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:4.hebrew: סוכתים - על שם שהיו יושבים בסוכות, כדכתיב (ירמיהו ל״ה:י׳) ונשב באהלים, וקרי להו "משפחת סופרים", דהיינו סנהדרין. וכן תרעתים — זקני שער:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:13:4.english: Sucathim - [They are called this] because they used to dwell in booths (*sukkot*), as it is written (Jeremiah 35:10) "And we dwelt in tents." And [Scripture] calls them "families of scribes," meaning the Sanhedrin. And similarly, Tirathim [means] the elders of the gate.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:14:1.hebrew: ועלינו מן הארץ מבעי ליה - יגרשונו מן הארץ. מאי "ועלה"? הלואי שיצאו שונאיהם מארצם, הואיל ויראים מפניהם:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:14:1.english: "And we will go up from the land" it should have said - They will drive us out of the land. What is [the meaning of] "and he will go up"? [It is as if saying:] If only their enemies would leave their land, since they are afraid of them.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:15:1.hebrew: מלבן - כמין דפוס שבו עושין הלבנים, שממלאין אותו טיט ומחליקין אותו, והיא הלבנה:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:15:1.english: Malben (brick mold) - A kind of mold in which they make the bricks; they fill it with clay and smooth it, and that is the brick.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:15:2.hebrew: ותלו לו לפרעה - דעליה קאי קרא, ומיניה סליק: ויאמר אל עמו וגו', הבה נתחכמה לו וגו', וישימו עליו שרי מסים:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:15:2.english: And they attributed it to Pharaoh - For the verse is speaking about him, and it proceeds from him: "And he said to his people, [etc.]... Come, let us deal wisely with him, [etc.]... and they set over him taskmasters."

Rashi on Sotah 11a:15:3.english: Astenis - Delicate and unable to do labor.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:16:1.hebrew: שרי מסים - דבר שמשים, רידוי של שומה, שמרגילין ומשימין לעבודה אותו מלבן שתלו לו. היה לישראל רידוי של השמה:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:16:1.english: Taskmasters [sarei missim] - A thing that imposes [meisim], a subjugation of assessment, in that they accustom [them] and impose upon [them] that labor of brick-making that was assigned to them. For Israel it was a subjugation of imposition.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:17:1.english: For the sake of afflicting him [i.e., Israel] before Pharaoh - On account of Israel's burdens, [that] they would bend their shoulders to bear [them].

Rashi on Sotah 11a:18:1.english: That endanger their owners - For through those cities and that labor, Egypt was endangered [and] drowned in the sea:

Rashi on Sotah 11a:18:2.hebrew: שממסכנות - מדלדלות, כדכתיב "וינצלו את מצרים", ובשביל עבודה זו אירע להן. ולהאי לישנא לא גרסינן "דאמר מר כל העוסק בבנין מתמסכן", ומאן דגריס לה מתרגמינן להך דרב ושמואל נמי. אכל בניינים של כל אדם — מסכנות: פעמים שנופל מהבנין ומת. ממסכנות — שמביא את האדם לידי עניות, דאמר מר כל העוסק בבנין מתמסכן:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:18:2.english: That they impoverish - [Meaning] they diminish [them], as it is written, "and they despoiled Egypt" (Exodus 12:36), and it was because of this labor that this happened to them. And according to this version we do not read [the line] "for the Master said: whoever engages in building becomes impoverished," and whoever does read it, we explain it in accordance with this [opinion] of Rav and Shmuel as well. But [as for] the buildings of any person, [they are called] "dangerous" — sometimes one falls from the building and dies. [The other opinion: "impoverishing"] — that it brings a person to poverty, as the Master said: whoever engages in building becomes impoverished.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:19:1.hebrew: ראשון ראשון מתרוסס - כשהיו בונין קצת, היה מתרוסס ונופל, וחוזרין ובונין, והוא נופל:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:19:1.english: The first one, the first one, would crumble - When they would build a bit, it would crumble and fall, and they would return and build, and it would fall.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:19:2.english: The mouth of the abyss swallowed it - It was swallowed in the earth:

Rashi on Sotah 11a:1:1.hebrew: הנני מקים וגו' - הציב אבשלום אותה עצה, וקיימה מצבת דבריו של הקב"ה, כדכתיב: לעולם ה' דברך נצב (תהילים קי״ט:פ״ט). ויקרא למצבת על שמו — גרם לאותה רעה שתקרא על שמו; ויקרא לה יד אבשלום, כך היא נקראת:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:1:1.english: "Behold, I will raise up [against you evil out of your own house]," etc. - Absalom set up (hitziv) that counsel, and he established it as a monument (matzevet) to the words of the Holy One, Blessed be He, as it is written: "Forever, O Lord, Your word stands firm (nitzav)" (Psalms 119:89). "And he called the pillar (matzevet) after his own name" — he caused that evil to be called by his name; and he called it "Yad Avshalom" (Absalom's Monument), so it is called.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:1:2.hebrew: וישלחהו מעמק חברון - ביוסף משתעי קרא, כששלחו יעקב אצל אחיו. והוא תחילת סיבת ירידת ישראל למצרים:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:1:2.english: And he sent him from the valley of Hebron - The verse speaks of Joseph, when Jacob sent him to his brothers. And this was the beginning of the cause of Israel's descent to Egypt.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:1:3.hebrew: של אותו צדיק שקבור בחברון - אברהם:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:1:3.english: Of that righteous man who is buried in Hebron - Abraham.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:20:1.hebrew: רוח הקדש מבשרתן - לישראל, ואומר למצרים: אין מועיל לכם, כן ירבה תמיד וכן יפרוץ:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:20:1.english: The Holy Spirit announces it - to Israel; and it says to the Egyptians: It does not help you, [for] "so shall they multiply" always and "so shall they spread out."

Rashi on Sotah 11a:20:2.hebrew: ויקוצו - היה דומה להן כאילו עיניהם וגופם מלאים קוצים בראותם את ישראל פרים ורבים:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:20:2.english: And they were disgusted - It seemed to them as though their eyes and their bodies were full of thorns, when they saw Israel being fruitful and multiplying.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:3:1.hebrew: אינו כן - דיותר ממה שהוא מודד, מודדים לו:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:3:1.english: It is not so - For they measure out to him more than what he himself measures.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:4:1.hebrew: דבאותה מדה - דוגמא מעין אותו ענין. ומיהו, יותר ממה שעשה משתלם, דמדה טובה מרובה בתשלומין ממדת פורענות:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:4:1.english: For in that same measure - [This is] an example similar to that matter. However, one is repaid more than what one did, for the measure of good is greater in repayment than the measure of punishment.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:5:1.hebrew: אמור לחכמה - שהיא אצל הקב"ה ומפיו, שנאמר: כי ה' יתן חכמה, מפיו דעת ותבונה (משלי ב׳:ו׳):
Rashi on Sotah 11a:5:1.english: Say to wisdom - For it is with the Holy One, Blessed be He, and from His mouth, as it is stated: "For the Lord gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding" (Proverbs 2:6).

Rashi on Sotah 11a:6:1.english: For it is not written "and he died" - [that is,] the king of Egypt, "and another reigned in his place."

Rashi on Sotah 11a:8:1.english: And let us deal wisely with their savior - To devise for ourselves a stratagem against him.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:9:1.hebrew: במה נידונם - שלא יוכל לדון אותנו בו, שידענו מדרכיו שמדד מדה כנגד מדה לדור המבול ולאנשי סדום:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:9:1.english: With what shall we punish them? - [We must find a way] that He will not be able to punish us by it, for we know of His ways that He measures measure for measure, [as He did] to the generation of the Flood and to the people of Sodom.

Rashi on Sotah 11a:9:2.hebrew: כי באש ה' נשפט - וכן ישיב לנו גמול:
Rashi on Sotah 11a:9:2.english: For by fire the Lord will execute judgment - And so He will repay us [with] recompense.

Tosafot on Sotah 11a:4:1.hebrew: ולעולם מדה טובה מרובה ממדת פורענות - וא"ת: הא מצינו מדת פורענות גדולה ממדת טובה, דכתיב: "איכה ירדוף אחד אלף ושנים יניסו רבבה" (דברים ל״ב:ל׳) גבי מדת פורענות, וגבי מדה טובה כתיב: "ורדפו מכם חמשה מאה" (ויקרא כ״ו:ח׳)? וי"ל: דעדיין גבי מדת פורענות מיירי רדיפה ולא הריגה, אבל הכא דכתיב "ורדפו מכם חמשה", סיפא דקרא: "ונפלו אויביכם לפניכם לחרב". מספר הישר:
Tosafot on Sotah 11a:4:1.english: "And always, the measure of good is greater than the measure of punishment" - And if you ask: But we find that the measure of punishment is greater than the measure of good, as it is written, "How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight" (Deuteronomy 32:30) regarding the measure of punishment, whereas regarding the measure of good it is written, "Five of you shall chase a hundred" (Leviticus 26:8)? And one can answer: that regarding the measure of punishment, it is still speaking only of chasing and not of killing; but here, where it is written "Five of you shall chase," the latter part of the verse [continues]: "and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword." From Sefer HaYashar.
